story_authority.rule: For the game's main story, Peter Jackson film continuity and the supplied trilogy screenplays are primary. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings is primary for deeper lore/history/cultures/geography/details not fully explained by the films, but book-only material may not silently replace film events or outcomes.

primary_deep_lore_sources.scope: The Lord of the Rings including Appendices

precedence: current ProjectGovernor hard invariants and approved game-specific implementation decisions
Peter Jackson film trilogy and supplied trilogy screenplays for film chronology, visible staging, dialogue context and required outcomes
Tolkien The Lord of the Rings + Appendices for deeper lore/history/geography/cultures when compatible with film continuity
Sources 01-11 for production interpretation, mission structure, assets, gameplay, world states, presentation, technical and QA rules
Source 10 generated visual plates for modeling aid only after canon/source cross-check
Bible 09 external-resource discovery for candidate assets/tools only; never canon evidence
DESIGN/ORIGINAL only after higher sources are insufficient and only inside a canon-safe narrative window
story_authority.runtime_rule: Raw source PDFs remain reference-only and never ship as runtime dependencies.

source_set_summary.source_library_shape: Sources 01-11 + three film screenplays + one full Tolkien LOTR volume; Source 00 remains project rules/governance rather than a shipped/reference PDF.
source_set_summary.rule: Film trilogy + supplied screenplays control film-driven chronology, visible staging and outcomes. Tolkien is the primary deeper-lore source when the films are silent and may not silently replace film continuity. Sources 01-11 are production references; Source 09 is helper-only and Source 10 is a visual modeling aid that must be cross-checked.

review_audit.scope: Project Source library re-audited after Source 10, Source 11, the Return of the King screenplay and the full Tolkien volume were added. Identity/page count/SHA256 were verified; Source 10 was visually reviewed as a modeling atlas, Source 11 was reviewed end-to-end, and primary references were structurally verified. This is not a full line-by-line canon audit of all 1,210 Tolkien pages or every screenplay scene.

reviewed_sections.application: Film-safe optional windows, lane-local/global persistence, no future knowledge; Part III not screenplay-verified.
Mission pre/postconditions, independent logic/art readiness and explicit QA scenarios.
Visual references establish intended appearance only; no inference of unseen canon or final visual acceptance.
Visual modeling aid: character/adversary sheets, multi-view production modeling, materials/gear and homeland/shadowland location plates; generated details require film/Bible cross-check.
Master source hierarchy plus audio, cinematics, UI/UX, living-world AI, UE4.27.2 technical, performance, QA/save and integration rules.
Part III screenplay identity and opening sequence verified; now valid primary Part III story authority.
Full-volume identity and contents verified; includes all six books and Appendices A-E and serves deeper-lore authority below film story continuity.

review_audit.chapter_id_warning: Bible F1-xx mission packages and runtime P1Cxx chapters are different identifiers. Never map by matching the numeric suffix. Match location, preconditions and outcomes against the screenplay and runtime atlas.
